description: Occlusions of the snitch in the first 1200 test clips (sorted by name), moving camera. An occlusion is a run of frames [start, end) on which the snitch is not visible (visibility_rate_gt_0.txt of the dataset), at least 5 frames long, starting at frame 16 or later and ending at least 3 frames before the end of the clip, and preceded by 3 frames on which the snitch covers at least 20 pixels of the rendered modal mask. `kind` is carried if at least 5 of its frames are in containment_with_move_annotations.txt, else contained if at least as many frames are contained as occluded, else occluded; `motion` is moved if the snitch's amodal box centre moves at least 10 px from its position at `start` during the occlusion. Every moved occlusion is kept; 50 static ones are drawn at random (seed 0) in proportion to the static occlusions of each kind and length (5-9, 10-29, 30+ frames).
